disclosure: standard direct-optimizer strengthening designed after observing old fixed-step MSPG diagnostics; not preregistered for the whole study

optimizer.geometry: Euclidean projected gradient ascent in normalized z=x/scale coordinates
optimizer.weighted_projection: z_i=clip(v_i-tau*scale_i, lo_i/scale_i, hi_i/scale_i), tau chosen so sum(scale_i*z_i)=1
optimizer.gradient_direction: analytic gradient with respect to z: grad_x multiplied by scale
optimizer.line_search_failure: stop that start and retain its best continuous-objective iterate
optimizer.stationary_condition: stop when normalized projected step norm or projected directional derivative is below tolerance
optimizer.best_iterate: highest frozen continuous objective, initialized with step0; ties retain earliest iterate
optimizer.objective: same frozen Q minus 10 times summed squared normalized two-sided window violation

terminal.lattice_projection_and_audit: same frozen 0.01 percent projection and evaluator

comparison.per_template_n: minimum eligible unique count across five methods capped at 20
comparison.selection: highest Q first then farthest normalized distance with Q tie-break

guardrails: No generator retraining, GA combination, other case, figure, or manuscript edit.
Maximum updates is a gradient budget, not an equal-total-cost claim.
Backtracking forward evaluations are reported separately.
Monotonicity does not imply a global optimum.
No tuning is performed to make MPGA beat or lose to G, R, BHR, or MSPG.
